nodes.name: power_5v
nodes.description: TPS54331 buck converter generates VCC_5V from VIN_12V. EN tied to VIN for always-on operation. BOOT requires capacitor to PH for high-side drive. SS soft-start, COMP compensation, and VSENSE feedback need external networks. This module is the VCC_5V distribution hub for downstream converters.

nodes.name: BOOT
nodes.description: Bootstrap capacitor connection for high-side MOSFET gate drive

nodes.name: EN
nodes.description: Enable input, active high, <1.25V disables device, float to enable

nodes.name: SS
nodes.description: Soft-start programming pin, external capacitor sets output rise time

nodes.name: VSENSE
nodes.description: Inverting input of transconductance error amplifier, feedback sensing node

nodes.name: COMP
nodes.description: Error amplifier output and PWM comparator input, connect frequency compensation components

nodes.name: PH
nodes.description: Switch node, source of internal high-side power MOSFET

nodes.name: power_boost_12v
nodes.description: TPS61088 boost converter generates boosted 12V load rail from VCC_5V. EN tied to VCC for always-on. MODE pin configures operating mode (PFM/PWM). FSW sets switching frequency. BOOT requires capacitor to SW. Multiple SW and VOUT pins for current handling. FB feedback and COMP compensation need external networks. ILIM sets current limit.

nodes.name: VCC
nodes.description: Internal 5V regulator output. Requires >1uF ceramic cap to GND.

nodes.name: EN
nodes.description: Enable, active high. Internal 800K pull-down. Tie to VIN for always-on.

nodes.name: FSW
nodes.description: Switching freq programming. Resistor from FSW to SW sets freq (200kHz-2.2MHz).

nodes.name: BOOT
nodes.description: High-side gate driver supply. 100nF cap to SW required.

nodes.name: SS
nodes.description: Soft-start programming. Cap to AGND sets ramp rate.

nodes.name: NC_1
nodes.description: No connect. Connect to GND plane for thermal dissipation.

nodes.name: NC_2
nodes.description: No connect. Connect to GND plane for thermal dissipation.

nodes.name: MODE
nodes.description: Light load mode. GND=forced PWM, floating=PFM. Internal 800K pull-up.

nodes.name: FB
nodes.description: Feedback input. VREF=1.204V. Resistor divider from VOUT.

nodes.name: COMP
nodes.description: Error amplifier output. Type II compensation network to AGND.

nodes.name: ILIM
nodes.description: Peak current limit programming. Resistor to AGND.

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO generates VCC_3V3 from VCC_5V. No enable pin; always on when VIN present. Input and output need bypass capacitors. This module provides VCC_3V3 to downstream loads including the 1.8V LDO.

nodes.name: power_1v8
nodes.description: ME6211 LDO generates VCC_1V8 from VCC_3V3. CE tied to VIN for always-on operation. NC pin is no-connect. This module provides VCC_1V8 to downstream loads.

nodes.name: CE
nodes.description: Chip Enable. ME6211C: active high (>=1.0V ON). Tie to VIN for always-on.

nodes.name: power_supervisor
nodes.description: TPS3703 voltage supervisor monitors VCC_5V rail for undervoltage/overvoltage conditions. SENSE input connects directly to VCC_5V rail. VDD powered from VCC_5V. CT sets reset delay timing with external capacitor. RESET output is open-drain and asserts POWER_GOOD signal. MR manual reset input can be tied to VCC if unused.
Single-channel voltage supervisor monitoring the 5V rail

nodes.name: SENSE
nodes.description: Monitored voltage input. Internal resistor divider sets OV/UV thresholds. Connect to VDD if monitoring VDD directly.

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage 1.7-5.5V. Optional 0.1-1uF bypass cap to GND for noisy supplies.

nodes.name: CT
nodes.description: Delay time programming. Open=short delay, 10K to VDD=long delay, cap to GND=programmable, GND=latch mode.

nodes.name: RESET
nodes.description: Active-low open-drain output. Asserted when SENSE outside OV/UV window. Requires external pull-up resistor to logic supply.

nodes.name: MR
nodes.description: Manual reset, active low. Internal 100K pull-up. Leave floating or tie to VDD if not used.
